headlines.title: The AI Futures Project updates its AI timelines after METR's report on Anthropic R&D, saying it now expects a Superhuman AI Researcher to arrive in 2027 (AI Futures Project)
Oura agrees to acquire AI and on-demand doctor service Counsel Health for $625M, says Q4 revenue grew 153% YoY to $533M and FY 2026 revenue grew 92% to $1.75B (Mark Gurman/Bloomberg)
Updated S-1: Anthropic's seven co-founders will sell $1.75B of stock in next week's IPO, each offering shares worth ~$250M at the midpoint of its IPO range (Dylan Sloan/Bloomberg)
Google rolls out Gemini 4 Carbon to paid API and AI Ultra users two weeks after releasing it to cyber defenders, and previews a swarm feature in Antigravity (Koray Kavukcuoglu/Google)
AI accounting startup Sumary raises $25m seed
OpenAI launches Businesses in ChatGPT in beta, including Business Agents for companies to interact with users and a hub where companies can claim their profiles (Jay Peters/The Verge)
Graphon Labs raises $35m to give AI agents a memory that lasts
Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare to take on hospital paperwork
Anthropic unveils office tools, including a video call assistant, a data dashboard, and spreadsheet service Claude Sheets, in a bid to compete with Microsoft (Shirin Ghaffary/Bloomberg)
New York Governor Kathy Hochul launches the US' first effort to independently test AI systems and train a new generation of AI safety experts via a new center (Calder McHugh/Politico)
Goldman, a lead bank on Anthropic’s IPO, sees $685B in revenue by 2030
Dreeze, launched by Zerto founders to help companies recover from cyberattacks by restoring entire cloud applications, emerges from stealth with a $33M seed (CTech)
Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon with agent ‘swarm’ feature
After challenging Google’s Android with Cyanogen, its co-founder takes aim at Windows for AI era
Startup Founders Are Using AI To File Patents. Here’s Where DIY Becomes A Liability.
Exclusive: Nvidia bet Hiverge quietly raises $19.4m backed by Plural
AI hardware startup Nominal triples valuation to $3B in 8 months
The realities of scaling AI agents: ‘You don't have an AI problem, you have a content problem’
ChatGPT is getting verified AI ‘Business Agents’
Anthropic adds Claude Sheets and a call assistant, taking on its backers
Anthropic has its own AI-powered office suite now
Meta and IMAX sign deal to put an IMAX theatre in Meta’s VR Glasses
eBay appears to have shut the door on third-party AI agents
DeepMind reveals Gemini Robotics 2.5 and open safety benchmark "ASIMOV-jailbreak"
